bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within the secondary family if secondary tests are reported
bootstrap.non_inferiority_ci_rule: lower bound of paired 95% garment-identity-bootstrap CI > -0.02
bootstrap.paired_preservation: keep paired predictions for all compared models

pre_outcome_gates: no leakage from train to test during PCA or scaling
same classifier family used for all feature sets
provenance and hash checks pass before outcome boundary
mechanical validity gate passes before predictive interpretation

L_14.definition: PCA14 of the frozen DINOv2 representation within each identity-disjoint fold
L_14.fitting_rule: fit each transformation within training rows only, apply to held-out rows
L_14.ordering: raw L -> training-fold PCA14 -> training-fold StandardScaler -> frozen LogisticRegression
